title: Owner can pause deposits
hypothesis: The contract owner can call pause and stop all deposits. Users cannot deposit while the vault is paused.
claimed_impact: Deposits stop while the owner keeps the vault paused
mechanism: pause is callable by the owner at any time
preconditions: The attacker controls the owner account
scope_statement: Administrative controls are in scope for this review
reproduction_summary: Step 1: call pause as the owner. Step 2: attempt a deposit.
code_excerpt: pub fn pause(&mut self) { self.assert_owner(); self.paused = true; }
